module: Node "Custom Lua" (category repeat_instant, color debug). Lets you write Lua code directly in the flowgraph editor, with custom input/output pins (saved). Four code blocks: work (every frame if an input flow is active), _executionStarted, _executionStopped and onPreRender. The code is compiled with load in a restricted environment (buildBaseEnv) and run under pcall; errors are logged on the node. The editor allows naming the node and saving it to a library (preference flowgraph.general.customLuaNodes).
notes: The code is executed without a useful argument: pcall receives debug.traceback as the chunk's argument.
The environment exposes require, dofile, loadfile, load, io and os: the code is not sandboxed.
The error log tag in exec contains a stray quote: 'Custom Lua Node: " .. code'.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class; each instance represents a node in a graph.

init.desc: Creates the four empty code blocks and allows custom input and output pins (savePins=true).

compile.desc: Compiles the given code block with the base environment; stores the error message in self.status, otherwise the function in self.compiled (nop on error).

drawCustomProperties.desc: Draws the editor: loading from the library, name, save button, and a multiline field per block with a compile error indicator. Returns the description of the change or false.

_executionStarted.desc: Compiles the four blocks then runs _executionStarted.

exec.desc: Runs the compiled block under pcall; on error, logs, marks the node as in error and adds an event to the manager.

_onDeserialized.desc: Restores name and code then recompiles.

buildBaseEnv.desc: Builds (once) and returns the environment table of the user code: self, map, be, FS, scenetree, extensions, vec3/quat, JSON and math tools, all loaded extensions, etc. Also provides refreshExtensions, loadExtension, unloadExtension, log (also logs to the manager).
